reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Added retry policy for inbound requests that automatically resets the requests that the service has not seen/processed", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Inbound requests that the service has not seen/processed are automatically retried. The default behavior changes to enable retry policy; this can be reverted by setting ENABLE_INBOUND_RETRY_POLICY to false.

proposed.statement: Istio 1.24.0 adds an automatic retry policy for inbound requests that the service has not processed, enabled by default and controllable via the ENABLE_INBOUND_RETRY_POLICY environment variable.
